paper_recipe_vs_adaptation: Controlled project ablation: TP-YOLOv8 reports SGD lr0=.01 from scratch; Ultralytics fine-tuning guidance discusses lower learning rates and warns auto optimizer overrides lr0. Keep optimizer SGD and all previous settings, reduce only lr0 to .001 as a hypothesis, not a paper reproduction.
limitations: Validation was already used to select prior checkpoint and has only six negative images; its repeated use is exploratory and may overfit. Previously reported test and TAD normal probe are consumed, so this run does not evaluate them. No guarantee of reduced false alarms. Compare validation mAP and losses, not train loss alone. This is a fresh run rather than exact continuation; no inference on consumed test/normal probe for selection.
hardware_decision: workers=0 to reduce RAM use after DataLoader worker OpenCV allocation failure; batch 8, image 640, SGD and LR unchanged. This changes loading process only, but stochastic reproducibility across worker counts is not guaranteed.
experiment_purpose: Repeat the same SGD lr0 .001 pilot from original COCO pretrained weights for all 60 epochs; disable early stopping to inspect epochs 49-60 and validation. Earlier 48-epoch run is finished and cannot be faithfully resumed because optimizer/scheduler state was stripped.
